rationale: Micah's expertise in building visual interfaces for machine learning systems and graph data directly complements Georgi's work automating GTM workflows with AI agents—Georgi's multi-agent platform could benefit from the kind of visual intuition and interactive tooling that Micah specializes in. Both are San Francisco–based founders focused on making AI systems more accessible and actionable: Micah through data visualization and human-centered design, Georgi through no-code automation and community-driven distribution at hackathons.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Georgi—you're both SF founders building AI tooling with a focus on making complex systems accessible to non-experts, and Georgi's GTM automation platform could be a great use case for the kind of visual interfaces and interactive design you pioneer.
